title: Sort each fraction by its decimal expansion
instructions: For each fraction, decide whether its decimal expansion TERMINATES or is NON-TERMINATING (repeating). Hint: look at the denominator after reducing to lowest terms. If it is 2^m · 5^n only — terminates. Otherwise — non-terminating.

bins.name: Terminating
bins.description: Denominator (in lowest terms) has ONLY 2's and 5's as prime factors.

bins.name: Non-terminating (repeating)
bins.description: Denominator has a prime factor OTHER than 2 or 5.

bins.name: Irrational (not rational at all)
bins.description: Cannot be written as p/q; decimal is non-terminating, non-repeating.
